title: baccaurea macrophylla
intro: Baccaurea macrophylla, commonly known as the large-leaved baccaburea, is a species of plant in the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant is a shrub or small tree that is native to Southeast Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Baccaurea macrophylla include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
